summary: Default the opt-in HTTP MCP transport to loopback-only (127.0.0.1:7777) so an operator enabling --transport http does not silently expose the MCP server and its process-bound Exa credentials to all interfaces.
reason: Greptile policy gate requires a 4/5 confidence score; the 3/5 review flagged the generated default binding to :7777 on all interfaces. Localhost-by-default is the safe default; remote hosts opt in with --addr 0.0.0.0:7777.
validated_outcome: go build ./... passes; HTTP transport now binds loopback by default.
